skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students understand the differences in multicultural environments and the challenges faced by companies operating in such environments.
Students can analyze and evaluate the factors affecting multicultural management in international businesses.
Students apply knowledge to analyze cultural differences and identify issues in multicultural environments.
Students use skills to make decisions in international management situations.
Students demonstrate independent working ability and adaptability in multicultural management.
Students understand social responsibility, ethical issues, and citizen rights, applying them in business management and personal life.
Students adapt to multicultural environments and manage cultural diversity effectively.
Students communicate effectively in multicultural settings and negotiate successfully.
